# ElevenLabs ConvAI widget

- Package: `@elevenlabs/convai-widget-embed`
- Version: `0.16.3`
- Source: https://unpkg.com/@elevenlabs/convai-widget-embed@0.16.3/dist/index.js
- Vendored: 2026-08-19

`libsamplerate.worklet-2.1.2.js` is the widget's pinned audio-worklet
dependency from
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@alexanderolsen/libsamplerate-js@2.1.2/dist/libsamplerate.worklet.js.
The vendored widget points to this same-origin copy so public docs do not load
runtime JavaScript from a third-party CDN.
